title: Rental Depreciation & Tax Shield Modeler
description: Given a rental property's basis, an optional cost segregation split with bonus depreciation, and income/tax context, runs the 27.5-year mid-month residential schedule plus any 5-year and 15-year components, tests the resulting loss against the passive activity loss rules, and optionally prices the section 1250 recapture and capital gain tax at an assumed sale. Offers both a corrected 27.5-year schedule (verified to sum to basis) and a legacy variant matching the original source spec's formula for comparison.
data_vintage: 2026.07 (MACRS 27.5-year residential; bonus depreciation per OBBBA and IRS Notice 2026-11; Rev. Proc. 2025-32 brackets)
